user_saw: Developers saw Control UI size-budget reports rise or fall when generated asset hashes changed.
summary: The fix normalizes generated asset hashes before measuring compressed bytes for Control UI budgets and continues reporting actual served sizes.
reasoning: I checked the original budget collector in #106367 and confirmed that it deliberately enforced limits using the measured sizes of the shipped gzip and Brotli sidecars. The fix changes the budget policy to isolate code growth from compression differences caused by generated names.
